name: Anupam Finserv Limited
about: Anupam Finserv Limited, a non-deposit accepting non-banking finance company, engages in granting of loans and advances in India. It operates through two segments, Financing and Leasing. The company offers capital solutions, including co-lending and LSP partnerships, as well as term loans for NBFCs. It also provides solar financing, wholesale lending, MSME and personal loans, and EV and green financing products. The company was formerly known as Vantage Corporate Services Limited and changed its name to Anupam Finserv Limited in November 2018. Anupam Finserv Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
